evidence: Situated on the picturesque Đinh Tiên Hoàng Street, adjacent to the serene Hoàn Kiếm Lake, the Thăng Long Water Puppet Theatre stands as a charming sanctuary of traditional Vietnamese artistry. Since its inception in 1969, the theatre has been a beloved cultural institution, preserving the rich heritage of water puppetry and celebrating the enduring legacy of the ancient wet rice civilization.
